test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Who among the following is NOT an exponent of Mohiniyattam classical dance form?
solution:
The correct answer is ​**__Prateeksha Kashi__.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Prateeksha Kashi i**s an accomplished Indian classical dancer, choreographer, and teacher.
 
• **She is best known for her expertise in Kuchipudi,** a classical dance form from Andhra Pradesh, India.
 
• Prateeksha has performed extensively both in India and abroad and has also trained many students in classical dance.
 
• She runs her own dance school in Bangalore, Kalavidaru Institute of Fine Arts.
 
• She was honoured with the title **"Yuva Kala Bharathi" by Bharath Kalachar, Chennai,** and was also the recipient of the **"Kala Shri" award by the Karnataka Sangeet Nritya Academy. **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Smitha Rajan **is an Indian** Mohiniyattam performer **from Kerala and granddaughter of the Indian classical dancer couple of Padma Shri Kalamandalam Krishnan Nair and Kalamandalam Kalyanikutty Amma.
 
• Jayaprabha Menon is Mohiniyattam dancer that have been eloquent demonstrations of talents groomed by venerated Gurus like Kalamandalam Saraswathy, C V Chandrasekhar, and Bharathy Shivaji. 
 
 
• Jayaprabha Menon is the director of the International Academy of Mohiniyattam, New Delhi.
 
 
 
• **Radha Datta **was the very first teacher of Mohiniattam around the Washington, DC area. Radha is also well known performer cum teacher of Bharatanatyam and folkdances, in the Washington, DC area.
